_comment: Per-pipeline bids-filter inputs for the `select` stage. `anat_acquisition` is the canonical T1w acq label (SagMPRAGE; the legacy MPRAGEPromo is skipped at curation, see curation.py::SKIP_ACQUISITIONS). `tasks` mirrors the functional task set of curation.py::ACQUISITION_MAP (9 single + 11 dual). network_fmri shells `network-qa render bids-filter` with these to write code/bids-filter_<pipeline>.json — the COARSE filter (canonical anat + all valid task bolds). `per_session: true` ALSO renders one code/bids-filter_<pipeline>_<subid>_<sesid>.json per subject-session, which drops scans excluded by `exclude_sources` (a task is only droppable when every run of it in that session is excluded; anything unexpressible stays enforced at lev1). fMRIPrep opts in because BABS fans out per subject-session and a truncated run that crashes the app fails the whole job; MRIQC does not, because it should measure every acquired run.
